chapter_seo_title: Chapter 175: The Gate Is Open – Danyangzi Confronts the Mao Gate
chapter_meta_description: Danyangzi reaches the gate to immortality, only to read "Mao Gate" instead of "Southern Heavenly Gate." Li Huowang invades his body and soul in a final, psychological war.
og_title: The Gate of Lies: Danyangzi's Universe Shatters
og_description: The promised Southern Heavenly Gate is a lie. Li Huowang mounts his final torment from within Danyangzi's own body, dragging him into a corrupted White Jade Capital.
twitter_title: No Immortal Realm – Just the Mao Gate
twitter_description: Danyangzi's lifelong goal is revealed as a fraud. Li Huowang, fused inside him, drives him into a horrifying vision of the White Jade Capital.
